meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本自动生成无脸解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把文章或笔记快速变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn articles or notes into explainer videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的文章、笔记或话题变成一段“无脸”解说视频——画面全是自动生成的文字、图表和抽象图形，不需要你提供任何网站或实拍素材。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字（文章、笔记、话题等），并明确要求制作解说视频时触发。如果只是说“做个视频”或不确定，Claude 会先引导你确认需求。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一个无脸解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会开始创建项目并引导你完成后续步骤。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一个3分钟的概念讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会根据你指定的时长规划故事板。

say.text: 把这份清单做成一个列表式解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会按列表结构设计画面和旁白。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude turns your article, notes, or topic into a 'faceless' explainer video—all visuals (typography, diagrams, abstract graphics) are auto-generated; you don't need to provide any website or real footage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give a piece of text (article, notes, topic, etc.) and explicitly ask for an explainer video. If you just say 'make a video' or are unsure, Claude will first guide you to clarify the intent.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude will start creating the project and guide you through the steps.

say_en.text: Make a 3-minute concept explainer from these notes.
say_en.note: Claude will plan the storyboard based on your specified duration.

say_en.text: Turn this list into a listicle-style explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude will design visuals and narration in a list format.
